|reviews=* [[Jeff Hansen]], "Warrant Officer M'Kae", Neglected Card Series, [[Corellian Engineering Corporation (fan site)|Corellian Engineering Corporation]]. He also suggests playing M'Kae without tractor beams so that opponents expect them and avoid a Star Destroyer's location. == What changed on the image ==
[[File:Dagobah-D-warrantofficermkae-PC-Errata-2018-E-card-changes.png|none|900px|Before and after]]
Compared with [[Warrant Officer M'Kae (PC Errata 2017 slip)]] (31 May 2017): Same words as the previous version. This is a full card image again (348 × 490 pixels), with the white italic “E” in the black lower border.

The 2017 slip and the same area of the 2018 E card, scaled to the slip's width; nothing else is edited.
